description: Quantum Life product-event taxonomy. Single source of truth for the funnel events the platform emits. Generates strongly-typed PHP DTOs under app/Events/Taxonomy/ via scripts/codegen-events.php. Bump the file name (taxonomy.v2.json) for a breaking change; bump the version field for additive changes.

field_types.iso8601: ISO-8601 timestamp as PHP string (codegen maps to string)

events.name: EbookLandingViewed
events.description: Visitor loaded the free-E-Book landing page.

fields.name: placement_id
fields.doc: Which landing-page placement variant was served (A/B test, campaign id, source page).

fields.name: session_id
fields.doc: Anonymous session id from the visitor cookie.

fields.name: affiliate_id
fields.doc: Affiliate user_id captured from the sharing link, if the visitor arrived via one.

events.name: FreeAccountCreated
events.description: Visitor completed the free-account signup form. Always fires once per user.

fields.name: placement_id
fields.doc: Placement attribution carried from the landing page that converted the signup.

fields.name: affiliate_id
fields.doc: Sponsor user_id if the signup was attributed to a sharing link.

events.name: EbookDownloaded
events.description: Newly-created member downloaded (or re-downloaded) the lead-magnet E-Book.

events.name: UpgradeOfferShown
events.description: Paid-upgrade offer was rendered to a logged-in free member.

fields.name: placement_id
fields.doc: Which in-app placement showed the offer (dashboard banner, post-ebook modal, email link).

events.name: UpgradeCompleted
events.description: Member successfully purchased a paid plan. Source of truth for commission accrual triggers.

fields.name: placement_id
fields.doc: Placement attribution carried from the offer that converted the purchase.

fields.name: affiliate_id
fields.doc: Sponsor user_id who earns the commission, if attributed.

events.name: AffiliateTermsAccepted
events.description: Paid member explicitly accepted the affiliate ToS — unlocks sharing-link generation.

events.name: AffiliateLinkShareCreated
events.description: An eligible affiliate generated a new sharing link (placement-scoped share token).

fields.name: affiliate_id
fields.doc: user_id of the affiliate creating the link.

fields.name: share_token
fields.doc: Opaque token attached to outbound URLs.

fields.name: placement_id
fields.doc: Which placement context the share was generated from (dashboard, ebook reader, email signature).

events.name: AffiliateLinkClicked
events.description: Visitor clicked through an affiliate sharing link. Joined to FreeAccountCreated/UpgradeCompleted via session_id for attribution.

fields.name: placement_id
fields.doc: Placement attribution captured from the link payload.
